3D design spatial composition and drawing/art spatial composition may overlap substantially but use different representation and production contexts.

Performance listening may mean attentive musical listening; leadership active listening concerns interpersonal understanding. The shared phrase is potentially misleading.

Language pragmatics focuses on language use across cultures; communication practice applies those principles to broader interaction contexts.
